headline: 给智能体补网页与数据源的 Firecrawl 日增八百五十星，办公套件、代码图谱和压缩输出的技能一并涌入代理工作流。
headlineEn: Firecrawl added 850 stars as scrape-and-search infra for agents, while office editors, code graphs and shorter-output skills entered coding-agent workflows.

lead.name: firecrawl/firecrawl
lead.zh: 把网站收成干净 Markdown，并经同一 API 接搜索与五百五十多家数据源，可作本地 MCP 或自托管。
lead.en: Turns pages into clean markdown and exposes search plus 550-plus providers on one API, as a local MCP binary or a self-hosted server.
lead.why: 日常跑 Claude 与编程代理时，缺的往往不是模型，而是干净、可引用的网页与外部数据。Firecrawl 把抓取、搜索和数据源收成同一套接口。
lead.whyEn: Agents stall on messy pages more than on model quality. Firecrawl folds scrape, search and outside providers into one interface they can call.

sections.title: 办公文件与代码图谱进代理
sections.titleEn: Office files and code graphs inside agents

items.name: XinaTian/MROffice
items.zh: 浏览器里的开源办公编辑器，可改真实 Word、Excel 与 PPT，并提供 MCP 给 Claude 与 ChatGPT。
items.en: Open-source browser editors that operate on real Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, with MCP so Claude and ChatGPT can edit them.

items.name: Graphify-Labs/graphify
items.zh: 代码库连同文档、SQL 与 PDF 变成可查询图谱，本地做 AST 解析且每条边可解释，不靠向量库。
items.en: Parses a repository, its docs and schemas into a local knowledge graph agents can query, with deterministic ASTs instead of embeddings.

items.name: Ulika
items.zh: 面向用 Claude、Cursor 或 Codex 搭出来的网站，提供可视化编辑。
items.en: A visual editor for websites assembled with Claude, Cursor or Codex.

sections.title: 本机个人代理、Rust 改写与离席编程
sections.titleEn: On-device agents, Rust rewrites and work that continues

items.name: simplexai-labs/linger
items.zh: 个人代理完全跑在本机。作者称靠模型与运行时共设计，把能力放到消费级电脑。
items.en: A personal agent that stays on your PC, via model and harness co-design aimed at consumer machines.

items.name: erkamyaman/rust-anything
items.zh: 按原程序录下的行为逐块改写成 Rust，每一步对照录音校验，覆盖 TypeScript、Python 与 Go 等。
items.en: Records what an existing app does, then rewrites it in Rust one slice at a time against that recording.

items.name: sybil-solutions/inference-optimisation-skill
items.zh: 代理技能，针对本地 LLM 服务做爬山式加速，覆盖 decode、推测解码、prefill 与 KV。
items.en: A skill that hill-climbs local LLM serving speed across decode, speculative decoding, prefill and KV, for any hardware and quantization.

items.name: Omi CLI
items.zh: 在你离开之后仍继续工作的 AI 编程代理。
items.en: Coding agents meant to keep going after you step away.

sections.title: 工程门禁、品味、压缩输出与发布片
sections.titleEn: Engineering gates, taste, shorter output and launch films

items.name: addyosmani/agent-skills
items.zh: 把资深工程里的流程、质量门与实践打成技能包，让编程代理按阶段执行。
items.en: Encodes senior engineering workflows and quality gates so agents follow them from plan through review.

items.name: Leonxlnx/taste-skill
items.zh: 编程代理可拿到艺术指导、参考图和浏览器验收，少做模板感落地页。
items.en: Steers coding agents with art direction, reference shots and a live browser pass, away from stock landing pages.

items.name: JuliusBrussee/caveman
items.zh: 用更短回答与工具输出省 token，原文可还原。作者称每题花费比 Codex 低百分之二十一。
items.en: Shortens agent answers and tool output with originals still recoverable. The authors say cost per solved task is 21 percent below Codex.

items.name: TeaserKit
items.zh: 由你的编程代理来执导产品发布视频。
items.en: Puts your coding agent in the director seat for the launch video.
